nightmares.line: If you're not there to share the dreams and nightmares?
stanza: If you're not there to share the dreams and nightmares?

nightmares.line: To stay out of your nightmares
stanza: To stay out of your nightmares
See, I was in your dream last night
You said, because of course I did

somewheres.line: I was living in the weeds somewheres
stanza: I was a used shoes salesman
And I was working the graveyard shift
I was listening for the bell on the door hoping you'd walk in
I was living in the weeds somewheres
I was breathing through a straw in the swamp
And I was gasping for air, wondering what it was for
